Mountain Project says winter/spring snow climbs suit experts, but the 4th-class summer scramble is done Jul-Sep; a SummitPost late-season photo set covers mid Aug-mid Sep; Mazamas lists fall too. Snow on the Terrible Traverse varies by year (frozen snow 25 Jul, patches mid Aug, bare late Aug).

facts.text: Climbers kick loose rock down the scree above the Middle-North saddle and in the Bowling Alley; call out and stay out of the fall line (August).
The Terrible Traverse can keep snow patches into mid-August after heavy winters, and the ground under them is loose; later in the season it is all loose scree.
The Bowling Alley entrance is a short narrow ramp of good rock just past the traverse; a wide loose gully means you went too far.
Descending, the Bowling Alley can be downclimbed or roped down; when waiting below a rappel, shelter in the alcove on the north side.
Ice axe (late July to mid August, for snow on the traverse); 50-60 m rope for the Bowling Alley rappel (July to September)

From Pole Creek the trail runs through burned forest before an unmarked use-trail junction that is easy to blow past; camps at the moraine lakes near 7,500-8,000 ft shorten the summit day, and water is plentiful in the moraine in August.
In late July the traverse toward the Bowling Alley can still be frozen snow at dawn; kicking steps works but gives no real protection.

season.evidence: Searches (Mountain Project, SummitPost, Mazamas) found no page describing a North Sister West Face - Right route; the west face is mentioned only as the intimidating side with the Bowling Alley above. Season assumed summer like the 4th-class South Ridge finish. No logged ascent names it.

notes: or_south_ridge got only a Trailhead add (no pins stored). Peakbagger South Ridge ascents are the standard route via Pole Creek, the Hayden Glacier moraine and the Terrible Traverse/Bowling Alley. Possible missing route: Southeast Ridge (about 10 logged ascents named SE Ridge/Southeast Ridge/East Ridge, Soap Creek side, joins the South Ridge near the top); the SummitPost page returned 403, so it is NOT listed in missing. Also Northwest Ridge (2 logs) and Collier Glacier (1) unverified. West Face - Right could not be identified; the Bowling Alley is on the west side of the summit pyramid, so it may overlap the South Ridge finish.
